prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production illustration for a desktop web login page
Primary request: create a polished 3D isometric business operations scene for a Chinese order and delivery management platform. Show a clean miniature logistics workspace with a modern warehouse dock, stacked sealed cartons and two pallets, one compact delivery truck, a floating order document board, and subtle connected route lines that visually communicate order intake, shipment approval, dispatch, and reconciliation.
Input images: the two supplied screenshots are style and composition references only; do not copy their UI or text.
Scene/backdrop: seamless very pale icy-blue to white studio environment that can blend into a white-blue web page.
Style/medium: premium soft 3D product illustration, smooth ceramic and frosted acrylic materials, refined enterprise visual design, crisp but gentle.
Composition/framing: 16:10 landscape. Main visual mass on the left and center, keep the rightmost 32% calm and low-detail for an overlaid code-native login form. Use a slightly elevated isometric camera. Keep all objects fully inside the frame with generous breathing room.
Lighting/mood: bright diffused daylight, soft blue contact shadows, trustworthy, calm, efficient.
Color palette: white, ice blue, cobalt blue, periwinkle, tiny restrained cyan accents; no warm orange, no purple dominance.
Materials/textures: satin white architectural blocks, translucent acrylic interface planes, glossy blue accents, realistic soft shadows.
Constraints: no people; no words, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermarks, UI form fields, or embedded interface text. No text-like marks. No dark background. No excessive glow. No clutter. Must look like a final production website illustration rather than concept art.
